generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Wastewater treatment facility (污水处理设施). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Create a clean municipal wastewater-treatment facility in soft morning light from a raised walkway. Use the circular settling tank and bubbling aeration basin as distinct middle-ground zones divided by the safety railing. Show the coarse bar screen at the channel entrance and the dewatering press in the rear building opening. Along the near service platform, separate the dosing pump, large valve wheel, long-handled sampler, capped treated-water bottle and portable pH probe. One technician may stand behind the railing recording observations, with no readable clipboard. Keep water treatment realistic but visually clean. No sewage close-ups, bodily waste, overflowing tanks, readable hazard signs, uncovered chemicals, duplicate pipes as targets or implausibly pristine drinking-water imagery.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: circular settling tank, wastewater aeration basin, coarse bar-screen filter, chemical dosing pump, pipeline valve wheel, long-handled water sampler, treated-water sample bottle, portable pH meter probe, sludge dewatering press, non-slip plant safety railing.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
